title: Pocketwire Advance Line Tenure Bonus
content:
**Rule.** When the Pocketwire Advance line was opened at least 1095 days before the handling date, 30.00 is added to the room for a new advance; when it was opened at least 365 days but fewer than 1095 days before the handling date, 15.00 is added to the room; a younger line adds nothing to the room.

**Tenure.** The tenure is the number of calendar days from the opening date of the Pocketwire Advance line, as the line's record shows it, to the handling date. The age of the customer's personal account plays no part in it.

| Line opened before the handling date | Added to the room |
|---|---|
| 1095 days or more | 30.00 |
| 365 to 1094 days | 15.00 |
| Fewer than 365 days | Nothing |

**Boundary pairs (hypothetical).**

- A line opened exactly 1095 days before the handling date: 30.00. Opened 1094 days before: 15.00.
- A line opened exactly 365 days before the handling date: 15.00. Opened 364 days before: nothing.

**Illustration (hypothetical).** A customer whose line was opened two years before the handling date, about 730 days, has a tenure of at least 365 but fewer than 1095 days: 15.00 is added to the room.
